774.name: Minior Red Meteor
774.flavor_text: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.

775.name: Komala
775.flavor_text: It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.

776.name: Turtonator
776.flavor_text: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.

777.name: Togedemaru
777.flavor_text: When it’s in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

778.name: Mimikyu Disguised
778.flavor_text: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

779.name: Bruxish
779.flavor_text: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie’s spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.

780.name: Drampa
780.flavor_text: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it’s angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

781.name: Dhelmise
781.flavor_text: After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.

782.name: Jangmo O
782.flavor_text: Jangmo-o strikes its scales to communicate with others of its kind. Its scales are actually fur that’s become as hard as metal.

783.name: Hakamo O
783.flavor_text: Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its scales together and roars. Its sharp claws shred the opposition.

784.name: Kommo O
784.flavor_text: Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.

785.name: Tapu Koko
785.flavor_text: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.

786.name: Tapu Lele
786.flavor_text: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.

787.name: Tapu Bulu
787.flavor_text: It makes ringing sounds with its tail to let others know where it is, avoiding unneeded conflicts. This guardian deity of Ula’ula controls plants.

788.name: Tapu Fini
788.flavor_text: Although it’s called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.

789.name: Cosmog
789.flavor_text: Cosmog is very curious but not very cautious, often placing itself in danger. If things start to look dicey, it teleports away.

790.name: Cosmoem
790.flavor_text: It sucks in dust from the air at an astounding rate, frantically building up energy within its core as preparation for evolution.

791.name: Solgaleo
791.flavor_text: Solgaleo was once known as the Beast That Devours the Sun. Energy in the form of light radiates boundlessly from it.

792.name: Lunala
792.flavor_text: It steals the light from its surroundings and then becomes the full moon, showering its own light across the night sky.

793.name: Nihilego
793.flavor_text: It appeared in this world from an Ultra Wormhole. Nihilego appears to be a parasite that lives by feeding on people and Pokémon.

794.name: Buzzwole
794.flavor_text: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.

795.name: Pheromosa
795.flavor_text: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

796.name: Xurkitree
796.flavor_text: They’ve been dubbed Ultra Beasts. Some of them stand unmoving, like trees, with their arms and legs stuck into the ground.

797.name: Celesteela
797.flavor_text: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

798.name: Kartana
798.flavor_text: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

799.name: Guzzlord
799.flavor_text: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.

800.name: Necrozma
800.flavor_text: It needs light to survive, and it goes on a rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will cut anything to pieces.

801.name: Magearna
801.flavor_text: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

802.name: Marshadow
802.flavor_text: This Pokémon can conceal itself in any shadow, so it went undiscovered for a long time.

803.name: Poipole
803.flavor_text: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.

804.name: Naganadel
804.flavor_text: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.

805.name: Stakataka
805.flavor_text: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute’s true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.

806.name: Blacephalon
806.flavor_text: A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents’ surprise to rob them of their vitality.

807.name: Zeraora
807.flavor_text: Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs. Wherever Zeraora runs, lightning flashes and thunder echoes.

808.name: Meltan
808.flavor_text: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.

809.name: Melmetal
809.flavor_text: Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal’s heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon.

810.name: Grookey
810.flavor_text: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.

811.name: Thwackey
811.flavor_text: When it’s drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won’t even notice that it’s already knocked out its opponent.

812.name: Rillaboom
812.flavor_text: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.

813.name: Scorbunny
813.flavor_text: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it’s raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

814.name: Raboot
814.flavor_text: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

815.name: Cinderace
815.flavor_text: It’s skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

816.name: Sobble
816.flavor_text: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.

817.name: Drizzile
817.flavor_text: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.

818.name: Inteleon
818.flavor_text: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes’ weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

819.name: Skwovet
819.flavor_text: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It’ll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.

820.name: Greedent
820.flavor_text: Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.

821.name: Rookidee
821.flavor_text: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

822.name: Corvisquire
822.flavor_text: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent’s strength.

823.name: Corviknight
823.flavor_text: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region’s airborne taxi service.

824.name: Blipbug
824.flavor_text: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

825.name: Dottler
825.flavor_text: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

826.name: Orbeetle
826.flavor_text: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what’s around it—and what’s around it can include things over six miles away.

827.name: Nickit
827.flavor_text: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

828.name: Thievul
828.flavor_text: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.

829.name: Gossifleur
829.flavor_text: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

830.name: Eldegoss
830.flavor_text: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

831.name: Wooloo
831.flavor_text: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won’t be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

832.name: Dubwool
832.flavor_text: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

833.name: Chewtle
833.flavor_text: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

834.name: Drednaw
834.flavor_text: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

835.name: Yamper
835.flavor_text: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

836.name: Boltund
836.flavor_text: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

837.name: Rolycoly
837.flavor_text: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.

838.name: Carkol
838.flavor_text: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

839.name: Coalossal
839.flavor_text: While it’s engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

840.name: Applin
840.flavor_text: As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.

841.name: Flapple
841.flavor_text: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

842.name: Appletun
842.flavor_text: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

843.name: Silicobra
843.flavor_text: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

844.name: Sandaconda
844.flavor_text: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

845.name: Cramorant
845.flavor_text: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.

846.name: Arrokuda
846.flavor_text: After it’s eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That’s when Cramorant swallows it up.

847.name: Barraskewda
847.flavor_text: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.

848.name: Toxel
848.flavor_text: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

849.name: Toxtricity Amped
849.flavor_text: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

850.name: Sizzlipede
850.flavor_text: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they’re well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

851.name: Centiskorch
851.flavor_text: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

852.name: Clobbopus
852.flavor_text: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn’t alarmed when that happens—it knows they’ll grow back. It’s about as smart as a three-year-old.

853.name: Grapploct
853.flavor_text: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

854.name: Sinistea
854.flavor_text: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.

855.name: Polteageist
855.flavor_text: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.

856.name: Hatenna
856.flavor_text: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.

857.name: Hattrem
857.flavor_text: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.

858.name: Hatterene
858.flavor_text: If you’re too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.

859.name: Impidimp
859.flavor_text: It sneaks into people’s homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.

860.name: Morgrem
860.flavor_text: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.

861.name: Grimmsnarl
861.flavor_text: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.

862.name: Obstagoon
862.flavor_text: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

863.name: Perrserker
863.flavor_text: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

864.name: Cursola
864.flavor_text: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You’ll become stiff as stone if you touch it.

865.name: Sirfetchd
865.flavor_text: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.

866.name: Mr Rime
866.flavor_text: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

867.name: Runerigus
867.flavor_text: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you’ll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.

868.name: Milcery
868.flavor_text: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.

869.name: Alcremie
869.flavor_text: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

870.name: Falinks
870.flavor_text: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

871.name: Pincurchin
871.flavor_text: It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one gets broken off, it still continues to emit electricity for at least three hours.

872.name: Snom
872.flavor_text: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.

873.name: Frosmoth
873.flavor_text: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

874.name: Stonjourner
874.flavor_text: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.

875.name: Eiscue Ice
875.flavor_text: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.

876.name: Indeedee Male
876.flavor_text: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.

877.name: Morpeko Full Belly
877.flavor_text: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they’re precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.

878.name: Cufant
878.flavor_text: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.

879.name: Copperajah
879.flavor_text: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

880.name: Dracozolt
880.flavor_text: The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity. Compared to its lower body, its upper half is entirely too small.

881.name: Arctozolt
881.flavor_text: This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores and was able to preserve food with the ice on its body. It went extinct because it moved so slowly.

882.name: Dracovish
882.flavor_text: Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokémon can’t breathe unless it’s underwater.

883.name: Arctovish
883.flavor_text: The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made this Pokémon go extinct anyway.

884.name: Duraludon
884.flavor_text: The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.

885.name: Dreepy
885.flavor_text: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.

886.name: Drakloak
886.flavor_text: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it’ll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.

887.name: Dragapult
887.flavor_text: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult’s horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.

888.name: Zacian
888.flavor_text: This Pokémon has slumbered for many years. Some say it’s Zamazenta’s elder sister—others say the two Pokémon are rivals.

889.name: Zamazenta
889.flavor_text: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.

890.name: Eternatus
890.flavor_text: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.

891.name: Kubfu
891.flavor_text: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.

892.name: Urshifu Single Strike
892.flavor_text: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

893.name: Zarude
893.flavor_text: Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

894.name: Regieleki
894.flavor_text: Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar’s electricity.

895.name: Regidrago
895.flavor_text: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.

896.name: Glastrier
896.flavor_text: Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.

897.name: Spectrier
897.flavor_text: As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs the life-force of sleeping creatures. It craves silence and solitude.

898.name: Calyrex
898.flavor_text: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.

899.name: Wyrdeer
899.flavor_text: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

900.name: Kleavor
900.flavor_text: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

901.name: Ursaluna
901.flavor_text: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

902.name: Basculegion Male
902.flavor_text: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

903.name: Sneasler
903.flavor_text: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

904.name: Overqwil
904.flavor_text: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

905.name: Enamorus Incarnate
905.flavor_text: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

906.name: Sprigatito
906.flavor_text: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

907.name: Floragato
907.flavor_text: The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

908.name: Meowscarada
908.flavor_text: With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what’s going on.

909.name: Fuecoco
909.flavor_text: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco’s head and flickers to and fro.

910.name: Crocalor
910.flavor_text: The valve in Crocalor’s flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

911.name: Skeledirge
911.flavor_text: Skeledirge’s gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

912.name: Quaxly
912.flavor_text: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

913.name: Quaxwell
913.flavor_text: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

914.name: Quaquaval
914.flavor_text: Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.

915.name: Lechonk
915.flavor_text: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.

916.name: Oinkologne Male
916.flavor_text: It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.

917.name: Tarountula
917.flavor_text: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread’s strength is the topic of ongoing research.

918.name: Spidops
918.flavor_text: Spidops covers its territory in tough, sticky threads to set up traps for intruders.

919.name: Nymble
919.flavor_text: It’s highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.

920.name: Lokix
920.flavor_text: It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can’t stay in this mode for long.

921.name: Pawmi
921.flavor_text: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

922.name: Pawmo
922.flavor_text: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

923.name: Pawmot
923.flavor_text: Pawmot’s fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

924.name: Tandemaus
924.flavor_text: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

925.name: Maushold Family Of Four
925.flavor_text: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

926.name: Fidough
926.flavor_text: The yeast in Fidough’s breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.

927.name: Dachsbun
927.flavor_text: The surface of this Pokémon’s skin hardens when exposed to intense heat, and its body has an appetizing aroma.

928.name: Smoliv
928.flavor_text: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

929.name: Dolliv
929.flavor_text: It basks in the sun to its heart’s content until the fruits on its head ripen. After that, Dolliv departs from human settlements and goes on a journey.

930.name: Arboliva
930.flavor_text: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.

931.name: Squawkabilly Green Plumage
931.flavor_text: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they’re out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

932.name: Nacli
932.flavor_text: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli’s body.

933.name: Naclstack
933.flavor_text: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

934.name: Garganacl
934.flavor_text: Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt.

935.name: Charcadet
935.flavor_text: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

936.name: Armarouge
936.flavor_text: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.

937.name: Ceruledge
937.flavor_text: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon’s evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.

938.name: Tadbulb
938.flavor_text: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.

939.name: Bellibolt
939.flavor_text: What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt’s belly-button dynamo.

940.name: Wattrel
940.flavor_text: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.

941.name: Kilowattrel
941.flavor_text: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

942.name: Maschiff
942.flavor_text: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

943.name: Mabosstiff
943.flavor_text: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

944.name: Shroodle
944.flavor_text: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

945.name: Grafaiai
945.flavor_text: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.

946.name: Bramblin
946.flavor_text: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.

947.name: Brambleghast
947.flavor_text: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.

948.name: Toedscool
948.flavor_text: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

949.name: Toedscruel
949.flavor_text: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

950.name: Klawf
950.flavor_text: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.

951.name: Capsakid
951.flavor_text: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

952.name: Scovillain
952.flavor_text: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

953.name: Rellor
953.flavor_text: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.

954.name: Rabsca
954.flavor_text: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.

955.name: Flittle
955.flavor_text: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

956.name: Espathra
956.flavor_text: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

957.name: Tinkatink
957.flavor_text: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.

958.name: Tinkatuff
958.flavor_text: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.

959.name: Tinkaton
959.flavor_text: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

960.name: Wiglett
960.flavor_text: Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of environmental adaptation.

961.name: Wugtrio
961.flavor_text: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.

962.name: Bombirdier
962.flavor_text: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

963.name: Finizen
963.flavor_text: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

964.name: Palafin Zero
964.flavor_text: Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen’s, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.

965.name: Varoom
965.flavor_text: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

966.name: Revavroom
966.flavor_text: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

967.name: Cyclizar
967.flavor_text: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.

968.name: Orthworm
968.flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.

969.name: Glimmet
969.flavor_text: Glimmet’s toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

970.name: Glimmora
970.flavor_text: Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

971.name: Greavard
971.flavor_text: This friendly Pokémon doesn’t like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

972.name: Houndstone
972.flavor_text: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn’t like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

973.name: Flamigo
973.flavor_text: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

974.name: Cetoddle
974.flavor_text: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

975.name: Cetitan
975.flavor_text: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

976.name: Veluza
976.flavor_text: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.
